lessonPractice.title: 点击保存后通常要等两秒，但系统不知道还剩多久。页面应该显示什么？

options.label: 按钮显示“保存中”和转圈图标，并防止重复提交
options.feedback: 对。短暂且无法估算完成度的等待适合 Spinner，并要说明正在做什么。

options.label: 按照两秒平均耗时，让进度条自动从 0% 走到 100%
options.feedback: 没有真实完成度时，虚假进度会误导用户。

options.label: 保持保存按钮可点击，只在页面角落显示统一加载提示
options.feedback: 加载提示离触发位置太远，而且按钮仍能重复点击。短暂保存应在按钮附近明确状态并暂时阻止重复提交。

en.title: Saving usually finishes in two seconds, but remaining work is unknown. What should appear?

options.label: Show a Spinner and Saving in the button, disabling duplicate submission
options.feedback: Correct. A brief wait with unknown completion suits a Spinner and should say what is happening.

options.label: Show Progress slowly moving from 0% to 100%
options.feedback: Without real completion, fake progress misleads people.

options.label: Show no state and update suddenly on success
options.feedback: People cannot tell whether the click worked and may submit again.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 保存操作开始后，请在当前按钮显示 Spinner 和“保存中”，禁用重复点击；成功或失败后恢复按钮并显示结果。模拟两秒等待和一次失败，确认不会重复发请求且两种结果都可见。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: When saving starts, show a Spinner and Saving in the current button and disable duplicate clicks; restore it with a visible success or failure result. Simulate a two-second wait and one failure, confirming no duplicate request and both outcomes are visible.

distinctions.label: Progress
distinctions.text: {c:spinner} only shows that work is still happening; it does not say how much is done. {c:progress} shows overall completion and, when measurable, a percentage.

distinctions.label: Skeleton
distinctions.text: {c:spinner} suits a brief local wait. {c:skeleton} reserves the shape of a larger page or content area before it arrives.
